description: Writing style skill template with built-in auto-learning for AI agents. AI writes initial draft using your style rules → you edit → scripts auto-extract new rules from diffs → SKILL.md improves over time. P0 rules auto-applied, backups created before each update. Works with Claude Code and OpenClaw/ClawHub. Includes observe.py (zero-dependency) and improve.py (LLM-powered) scripts.
